turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Well... I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to keep myself together lately. Ever since my daughter left for basic training, I feel like I come home to a dead house, and it's really getting to me. 

I'm sitting there crying in my truck before my shifts start. And at work—I do sheet metal work—I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years. I keep snapping at the younger guys on the crew, too. I don't even do the things I normally enjoy anymore. I’ve stopped going out on the water, and I haven't worked on my sculpture at all because I just... I don’t see the point right now. I just feel like I'm falling apart.
